facts.label: Sin City Pits
facts.tagline: American Pitbull Terrier breeder in Las Vegas. Est. 2012.
facts.siteNote: Litters, pedigrees and availability are on sincitypits.com

photos.alt: Sin City Pits flyer, Breeder Opportunity: three pit bull puppies, two grey and one tan. Available females with a breeding unit, from a select list of Sin City Pits studs, only with first or second pick.
Five Sin City Pits dogs composed on rocks under a stormy sky, named on the picture: SCP Disciple's Az, Melillo's Thor, SCP Az's Saint and SCP Queen Of Hearts.

facts.contactOnly: Sin City Pits breeds American Pitbull Terriers and runs a canine semen bank — not a kitchen, so there is nothing to order here. They publish no prices at all: litters, stud fees and shipping are quoted by conversation. Call them, or start on their site.
